Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a bait-based pull-down (AP-MS) approach with SILAC for quantification to identify proteins that bind to specific acyl-modified peptides or fatty-acyl beads. While the study investigates acyl-modifications, the MS analysis is performed on the proteins pulled down by the baits, not on the endogenous acyl-modified proteome itself (no PTM enrichment of the sample proteins is described; PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset').

scope: The peptide-bound beads (40 uL slurry) were incubated with 1 mg Hela nuclear extracts.

The bound proteins were eluted with 2x SDS sample buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH6.8, 4% SDS, 12% glycerol, 2% β-mercaptoethanol, 0.008% bromophenol), separated with the bait peptides on SDS-PAGE, and subjected to trypsin digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
C10:0 and C14:0 fatty acids were conjugated onto agarose beads, and used for pull-down with stable isotope (light: K0R0, heavy: K8R10) labeled Hela whole cell extract.

Nuclear extract was prepared by lysing cells in hypotonic buffer and salt extraction of nuclei.
